description: Corrected the initialization mapping bug in the `Block` class where instance attributes `self.x` and `self.x0` were incorrectly assigned to forward pass parameters (`self.x` and `self.x0`) instead of the class dictionary `self.resid_lambdas`. This caused the `MuonAdamW` optimizer to fail initialization on step 0 with empty tensors, crashing the training loop and reducing the val_bpb to 0.9910.
